_comment: Voice lines for the 'Let me check' ad. Read by scripts/make-voice.py (TTS) and src/call/*. Every product claim maps to app code: see src/call/claims.md.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi! Do you have a room this Friday? Two nights, two adults.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.text: Umm... let me check. Can you hold for a sec?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello? You know what, I'll just book somewhere online. Thanks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every "let me check" is a guest booking somewhere else.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Same night. Same guest. But this time, your hotel has its own booking site.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They see what's free, pick their dates, and book. No phone call.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every night is counted, so no room gets sold twice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Price every night on its own. Set all your Fridays and Saturdays at once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Housekeeping marks rooms clean from their phone. The front desk sees what's ready.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Arrivals, departures and occupancy, on one screen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Guests move or cancel their own booking, up to a day before check-in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And your whole team gets their own login, with only what they need.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your own booking site and front desk, for independent hotels and motels. See it live.
